versions.content: If SecOCQueryFreshnessValue = CFUNC AND SecOCProvideTxTruncatedFreshnessValue = FALSE for a PDU configuration, SecOC calls a function named SecOC_GetTxFreshness , to get the current freshness for TX messages.

If SecOCQueryFreshnessValue = CFUNC AND SecOCProvideTxTruncatedFreshnessValue = FALSE for a PDU configuration, Specification of Secure Onboard Communication AUTOSAR CP R20 - 11 36 of 179 Document ID 654 : AUTOSAR_SWS_SecureOnboardCommunication SecOC calls a function named SecOC_GetTxFreshness , to get the current freshness for TX messages.
